parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS chunk_id, d.title AS subject, d.sender_address AS from_address, d.received_at, d.project_code, d.metadata->>'project_name' AS project_name, c.content, 1 - (c.embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity FROM rag.chunk c JOIN rag.document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.source_type = 'EMAIL' AND ($2::text IS NULL OR d.project_code = $2) ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $1::vector ASC LIMIT 5;
